ren: Morning dilemma: should we serve croissants at Semver Karaoke or just comfort snacks? :croissant:
sam: Croissants. Also rename the event to 'Commitment Issues Night' 
aoife: Found a PR that had `version: 'v1 .2. 3'` and I responded with a GIF of someone patching a heart. :broken_heart:
luca: I propose a new rule: any YAML change must include one liner explaining its feelings. Example: 'fixed indent, feels seen'
ci-bot: ci-bot: \u26a0 Lint: invalid semver string 'v1 .2. 3'. Please use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Suggested fix: '1.2.3'.
ren: Also karaoke rules: sing your worst compiler error as a duet. I'll take "Segmentation fault" if anyone wants to partner. :microphone:
aoife: PR title I saw this morning: "fix: whitespace and my priorities" 10/10
sam: Poll: croissants (:croissant:), cookies (:cookie:), or nothing but empathy (:heart:)? React and ci-bot will tally in 30m.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Reaction poll registered. Results will be posted in 30 minutes.
